# Avatar (pfp)

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- PFP_PUSH_TWITTER — default: OFF — Allow `polyrob avatar push --twitter` to set the X profile image (v1.1 `update_profile_image`, OAuth1 from `TWITTER_*` env; decoupled from `TWITTER_ENABLED`; fail-open on 403).
- PFP_PUSH_TELEGRAM — default: OFF — Allow `polyrob avatar push --telegram [--telegram-chat ID]` to set the bot photo (`setMyProfilePhoto`, JPEG) and each named group's photo (`setChatPhoto`, bot must be admin); `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`; hash-idempotent, fail-open to the BotFathe…
- PFP_PUSH_DISCORD — default: OFF — Allow `polyrob avatar push --discord` to set the Discord bot avatar (`PATCH /users/@me`, `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN`; hash-idempotent, fail-open).
